companyUrls.description: LinkedIn company page URLs or slugs. Accepts: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/, https://www.linkedin.com/company/apple/about/, or just the slug: apple

cookie.description: Your LinkedIn session cookie. Accepts either: (1) the li_at value from browser DevTools Application Cookies, or (2) full cookies JSON array exported from an extension like EditThisCookie.
cookie.title: LinkedIn Cookie

includeShowcases.description: Also emit one record per LinkedIn showcase page referenced by each input company.
includeShowcases.title: Include showcase pages

language.description: Language code used for Accept-Language and the LinkedIn lang cookie.
